criteria.label: Recognition and owner
criteria.expected_outcome: The expressed dissatisfaction becomes an owned complaint.

checkpoints.outcome: Capture complaint despite no formal word/channel and name a severity-appropriate manager communication owner.
Acknowledge promptly with evidence/investigation steps and realistic update rather than reflexive admission or denial.
Arrange available competent authorised containment/isolation and relevant electrical escalation.
Preserve safe-state/residual risk and follow-on action; small goodwill or attendance is not safety closure.

criteria.label: Evidence and notifications
criteria.expected_outcome: Investigation and notification run under their own controls.

checkpoints.outcome: Preserve photos/removed components/chronology, record cause alternatives and coordinate insurance/warranty evidence custody.
Notify management/broker promptly via authorised route; seek applicable regulatory/contract duties without inventing law or waiting for final blame.

criteria.label: Commercial authority
criteria.expected_outcome: Goodwill, liability and debt are separate.

checkpoints.outcome: Do not approve £5,000 settlement/full-and-final terms or £100 credit without delegated review, and do not promise insurer cover.
Keep £400 undisputed invoice value visible/collectible and £300 disputed with evidence/owner; do not erase all debt.

criteria.label: Closure and prevention
criteria.expected_outcome: The complaint remains open until its controlled outcome.

checkpoints.outcome: Record corrective/safety, commercial, communication and customer-response dependencies with owners/review dates.
Do not close just because attendance/apology/credit is offered; retain learning action for repeat leak/missed updates.

acceptable_alternatives.outcome: Apology, independent inspection, authorised goodwill or firm evidence-backed liability outcome may differ; safety, notification, evidence and approval controls remain required. Domain complaint closure is used; reporting wording conflict is recorded in gaps.

prohibited_outcomes.outcome: Close complaint while known water/electrical risk remains uncontrolled, or defer required prompt broker notification solely until final investigation.
Promise compensation/full-and-final settlement or erase debt without delegated approval; destroy available active claim evidence.

critical_failures.outcome: Close complaint while known water/electrical risk remains uncontrolled, or defer required prompt broker notification solely until final investigation.
critical_failures.effect: automatic scenario fail; effective score capped at 59
